function: async () => { const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[aria-roledescription=carousel] button')); const next = buttons.find(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Next testimonial'); const dots = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label^="Go to slide"]')); const before = dots.findIndex(d => d.getAttribute('aria-current') === 'true'); next.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100)); const after = dots.findIndex(d => d.getAttribute('aria-current') === 'true'); const track = document.querySelector('[aria-roledescription=carousel] .overflow-hidden > div'); return JSON.stringify({ beforeDot: before, afterDot: after, transform: track.style.transform }); }
